chunks.chunk_id: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Animal Husbandry, Dairy & Fisheries-001
chunks.section: Scheme Purpose and Working Capital Coverage
chunks.source_document: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Animal Husbandry, Dairy & Fisheries
chunks.source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
chunks.text: The Government of India extended the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) facility to Animal Husbandry, Dairy, and Fisheries farmers to meet their short-term working capital requirements. It covers recurring expenses such as animal feed, veterinary medicines, vaccinations, electricity, water charges, breeding, and labor costs for dairy cows, buffaloes, sheep, goats, pigs, and poultry.

chunks.chunk_id: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Animal Husbandry, Dairy & Fisheries-002
chunks.section: Loan Limit and Subsidized Interest Rate
chunks.source_document: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Animal Husbandry, Dairy & Fisheries
chunks.source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
chunks.text: Farmers can avail collateral-free short-term working capital loans up to Rs. 2 Lakhs at a base interest rate of 7% per annum. With the Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI) of 3% provided by the Government, the effective interest rate is only 4% per annum for farmers who repay their dues on or before the due date. For farmers holding both crop and animal husbandry KCC, the total collateral-free limit is Rs. 3 Lakhs.

chunks.chunk_id: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Animal Husbandry, Dairy & Fisheries-003
chunks.section: Eligibility Criteria for Dairy and Poultry Farmers
chunks.source_document: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Animal Husbandry, Dairy & Fisheries
chunks.source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
chunks.text: Individual farmers, Joint Liability Groups (JLGs), Self Help Groups (SHGs), tenant farmers, and sharecroppers who own, rent, or lease animal sheds and livestock are eligible. Scale of finance is determined locally by the District Level Technical Committee (DLTC) based on unit cost per animal/bird.

chunks.chunk_id: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Animal Husbandry, Dairy & Fisheries-004
chunks.source_document: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Animal Husbandry, Dairy & Fisheries
chunks.source_name: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
chunks.text: Simplified one-page application form, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card or Form 60, Land records / rental agreement for the shed, bank account details, and animal ownership/health declaration. No processing fee is charged for KCC limits up to Rs. 3 Lakhs.
